notes.title: Update Version 0.8.7.0 Win11 bug fix
notes.content:
First of all, I apologize that it took me so long to discover the problem. Because I have been using the Win10 computer myself, everything in the game content is normal, but recently when I bought a new Win11 computer, I found that many skills in the game had problems, resulting in a very bad experience. The following content has been updated and fixed:
1. Robot, Robot EX: Fix bugs with abnormal missile flight speed
2. Eagle, Eagle EX: Fixed bug with abnormal flying speed in skill
3. Green Dragon, Green Dragon EX: Fixed a serious bug where the Awakening skill failed
4. Female Mage, Female Mage EX: Fixed bug in displaying heavy attack effects
5. Bullhead Monster, Bullhead Monster EX: Fix bug with strong suction in Awakening skill
6. Scarecrow, Scarecrow EX: Fix a bug where Scarecrow's heavy attack suction is too strong
7. Death Lord, Death Lord EX: Fixed serious bugs where heavy attack and awakening skills can cause abnormal effects in high frame rates
8. Fixed a bug in the laser skill effect display of the final boss's fear will
Thank you for your support. I will continue to work hard~

notes.title: Update Version 0.8.6.0
notes.content:
"Hello, this is the update log of this version:

1. Added achievement check function and fixed a bug in the old version where EX characters were unlocked but achievements were not completed!
2. Added a combo system to display your combo count! If there is no subsequent damage within 3 seconds, combo will return to zero~
3. Fixed a bug in Endless Mode where obtaining a must kill skill would clear items
4. Fixed a bug where trees in the Ice and Snow Canyon would block the mouse, making it difficult to aim
5. Fixed a bug where EX characters cannot be unlocked after their proficiency level reaches 500 in survival mode and endless mode
6. Fixed a bug in survival mode and endless mode where unlocking EX characters was unable to complete achievements"

notes.title: Update Version 0.8.4.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is the update log of this version:

The ability to invite friends has been added to the four multiplayer modes! Now you can directly invite Steam friends to join the game and fight together!

notes.title: Update Version 0.8.3.0
notes.content:
Hello, this is the update log of this version:

1. The character controlled by the player increases a certain percentage of life value to avoid the problem that the monster will die after touching a few times... (reduce the difficulty of the game)
2. Fix the problem that will affect the unlocking of the single archive character after the victory of the team battle (the affected archive cannot be recovered)
3. After optimizing the battle victory, you must click to continue the game. Now you can press the game handle (Xbox A key) to continue the game
4. The skill shock wave of the patrol robot increases the 0.8 second warning and increases the player's reaction time
5. Reduce the frequency of archer AI releasing arrow rain
6. The sickle mage EX with the probability of the 12th wave of survival mode is changed to ordinary sickle mage
